description: onestop hooks - one Node dispatcher in exec form, so they run natively on Windows, macOS and Linux with no shell. Every hook is silent outside an active onestop run, and in any session that did not open or resume the run. During a run the PreToolUse guard blocks destructive git, recursive deletes, publishes, deploys, downloads piped to a shell, unapproved dependencies, any commit, push or pull request the user did not choose at the ship gate, edits to the run ledger, and writes by read-only specialists outside their reports. SubagentStop stores each specialist's report as it finishes.
